test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements about the PM Electric Drive Revolution in Innovative Vehicle Enhancement (PM E-DRIVE) Scheme launched in 2024 is/are correct?

1. The scheme will remain in force until 31 March 2026.

2. One of the key aims of PM E-DRIVE is to provide direct subsidies to petrol and diesel vehicles to improve their fuel efficiency.

3. The scheme includes provisions to support the development of EV charging infrastructure.

4. PM E-DRIVE focuses exclusively on private vehicle ownership.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Only 1 and 3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **PM Electric Drive Revolution in Innovative Vehicle Enhancement (PM E-DRIVE) Scheme** was launched in **2024** to promote electric mobility in India.
 
• The scheme will remain in force until **31 March 2026**, ensuring focused efforts to enhance electric vehicle adoption during this period.
 
• One of the key provisions of the scheme is to support the development of **EV charging infrastructure**, which is critical for the growth and usability of electric vehicles in India.
 
• The scheme does not provide subsidies for **petrol and diesel vehicles**, as its focus is on promoting sustainable and clean energy mobility solutions.
 
• It does not exclusively target **private vehicle ownership**; the scheme is designed to benefit multiple sectors, including public and commercial transport, to accelerate the transition to electric mobility.
 
• The scheme aligns with the government's broader goal of achieving **net-zero emissions** and reducing dependency on fossil fuels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Option 2: Direct subsidies for petrol and diesel vehicles**__

 __
 
• This is incorrect because the **PM E-DRIVE Scheme** is focused solely on promoting **electric vehicles** and does not aim to subsidize conventional fuel vehicles such as petrol and diesel cars.
 
• The scheme is part of efforts to move away from fossil fuels and reduce **carbon emissions**, aligning with India's renewable energy and environmental goals.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Exclusive focus on private vehicle ownership**__
 __
 
• This is incorrect because the scheme encompasses a broader scope, including **public transport, commercial fleets, and shared mobility**, in addition to private ownership.
 
• The government aims to ensure the widespread adoption of electric vehicles across various sectors to maximize environmental and economic benefits.
 
 
 
• **Importance of EV Charging Infrastructure**__
 
 
• Developing robust **charging networks** is essential for the success of EV adoption as it addresses range anxiety and improves usability.
 
• It supports both urban and rural areas, ensuring equitable access to electric mobility solutions.
